messages.subject: Bug?  Multiple downloadLink's
parts:
Wondering if this is a bug or by design.  When I put more than one downloadLink in different parts of the app, to download the same object, neither link works.  But it works fine with just one downloadLink.  Looks like href doesn't get populated.  Here is the html that renders in the two scenarios:

Single downloadLink -- WORKS
<a id="download_map_data" class="shiny-download-link shiny-bound-output" href="session/3afca26095bba232b01c7b068e261828/download/download_map_data" target="_blank">Download map data</a>

Multiple downloadLink's -- NEITHER WORKS
Link 1: <a id="download_map_data" class="shiny-download-link" href="" target="_blank">Download map data</a>
Link 2: <a id="download_map_data" class="shiny-download-link shiny-bound-output" href="" target="_blank">Download map data</a>


Thoughts?
John
